description: This is a shell script designed to process SSL certificate files within specified directories. It scans files for certificate or CRL headers, computes their fingerprints and hashes using OpenSSL, and creates symbolic links based on these hashes to facilitate certificate management and rehashing.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Checks whether a given file contains a certificate or CRL based on header lines, returning a bitfield indicating the file type.

methods.name: fingerprint
methods.description: Uses OpenSSL to generate a fingerprint of a certificate or CRL file.

methods.name: link_hash
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link to a certificate or CRL file based on its hash and fingerprint, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: hash_dir
methods.description: Processes all relevant certificate files in a directory, creating hash-based symbolic links for each.
